questions.question_text: Explain the meaning of the key vocabulary term 'Invisible' in the context of 'The Chair'.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: Definition: Unable to be seen by the eye.. Example: He brought down a strange invisible chair.

questions.question_text: Provide a detailed summary (80-100 words) of 'The Chair', highlighting the character actions and moral outcome.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: Mario proudly took the invisible chair to school to prove his popularity. When he tried sitting on it, he missed and crashed twice, drawing laughter from his peers. Refusing to surrender, he tried again. This time he remained floating because three classmates—Guneet, Asma, and Deepa—held him up. Mario realized that while many were happy to laugh at him, only three were true friends who cared for him.

questions.question_text: What character arc is observed in 'The Chair'?
options: A) Learns to value real quality of friendship over popularity counts.
B) Remaining unchanged throughout the story.
C) Moving from wisdom to foolishness.
D) Abandoning home to live in exile.
questions.correct_answer: A) Learns to value real quality of friendship over popularity counts.

questions.question_text: Guided Writing Extension: Write a thank-you note from Mario to Deepa.
questions.marking_scheme_answer:
Format: Thank-you Note. Key Value Points: Express gratitude, Reference the chair test, Promise lifelong friendship.
Sample Output: Dear Deepa, Thank you so much for catching me when I was falling during the chair test. While others laughed, you stepped forward to help. I am truly blessed to have you as a friend for life! Warmly, Mario.
